usage: agent-capabilities.py [-h] --agent AGENT [--observation OBSERVATION]
                             [--policy POLICY] [--output OUTPUT]
                             {inspect,render}

Inspect declared/observed capability boundaries; render a scoped Claude
profile. This tool does not observe a live host or grant authority.
Observations and scope policies are explicit, externally supplied records,
never inferred from prompts.

positional arguments:
  {inspect,render}

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --agent AGENT
  --observation OBSERVATION
  --policy POLICY
  --output OUTPUT
